info.name: Aerospike REST Gateway Cluster Documentation API

description.content:
The Aerospike REST Gateway exposes the Aerospike database client API (cluster info, key-value, scan, query, operate, batch, UDFs, secondary indexes) over HTTP/JSON. The gateway is self-hosted alongside an Aerospike cluster; the default base URL is http://localhost:8080/v1. Interactive documentation is available at /swagger-ui.html and the OpenAPI JSON at /v3/api-docs on the running gateway.
